services.desc: Book a guided tour of the Morris Museum to enrich your experience! Private Tours are open to adult groups and families. See details below to find which tour fits your preference, and which areas of the museum you would like to discover. Take a journey into the past and discover the captivating history of Twin Oaks Mansion, a Neo-Georgian estate originally constructed in 1913 for Peter Hood Ballantine Frelinghuysen and his wife Adaline (née Havemeyer). This magnificent structure, which is now the heart of the Morris Museum, has served as our primary facility since 1964 and is over a century old.
